overview_description.description:
CallowBlue is a data analysis company providing programming services for banking sector. We create customized software and analyze operational costs and risks by implementing KYC/AML algorithms.

By doing analysis on blockchain, we are able to decrease the financial service providers back-end operational costs by up to 40% with our platform.
By allowing you to monitor launched digital assets in your network, auditing assets will now be completely automated and transparent for each counter party.

All this is done by a group of industry experts, backed by world-leading academics with backgrounds in legal protection, network analysis, data science and capital markets. We are here to change the way financial services landscape has existed so far.

For demo, contact us at info@callowblue.com
